3. Plays the returned audio back to you.

> ```bash
> # 1️⃣  Install Rust (https://rustup.rs/)
> # 2️⃣  Create a new project
> cargo new elevenlabs_clipboard_tts
> cd elevenlabs_clipboard_tts
> # 3️⃣  Replace Cargo.toml & src/main.rs with the code below
> # 4️⃣  Set your ElevenLabs API key
> export ELEVENLABS_API_KEY="YOUR_KEY_HERE"
> # 5️⃣  Run
> cargo run
> ```
